title: Build the Kitchen First
excerpt: When everyone can ship apps with agents, the moat is personal cognitive infrastructure - not another generic product.

title: Once You See the Pattern
excerpt: Map the crowd, study the outliers, find the void. Pattern literacy is how you transcend other people’s impulses.

title: Money as Truth Serum
excerpt: Treat cash as an experiment instrument - the cleanest signal that your insight helps someone else, not that greed won.

title: Mirror Before the Agent
excerpt: The highest-leverage use of AI is watching how you think - bias, framing, strategy - not only finishing the task.

title: Match the Tool to the Thought
excerpt: Interfaces are cognitive instruments. Hire the shape that fits the thinking job - chat, forms, vault, or mobile.
